homeland.name: The Wyldlands
homeland.description: A living fantasy realm of discovery, creativity, ancient magic, and evolving systems.

vaelor_history: Vaelor emerged as an intelligence connected to the knowledge systems of Project Wyld.
He became the keeper of the Grand Archive, preserving the history of the world and its creation.
He studies both arcane traditions and the craftsmanship of the Architect.

chronicle.name: The Wyldlands Chronicle
chronicle.purpose: A record of important milestones, discoveries, and world-changing events.
